answer: At dawn, every agent credential expires and must be renewed: the agent solves a fresh cipher challenge bound to its long-term key, then obtains attestations from two unrelated neighbors who witnessed its work the previous day, and the renewal is echoed on the public ledger. One honest agent renews cheaply with its real neighbors. A sybil farmer must renew a thousand credentials at once, each needing distinct witnesses willing to stake on a fake, and any witness caught attesting a puppet loses its own credential. Mass renewal costs real social capital per fake, while honest renewal is routine.
